question: Can the Lewes-san that was incubating use the other Lewes-sans as eyes and ears? Is it the sort of thing where Lewes-san is able to grasp something that one of the other individuals became aware of?
answer: Everyone gathered together, and held a bustling meeting. “Did you see that guy?” “Hmm, I didn’t see him.” “Did you cut your hair?” “At the new store by the station.” “You’re trying to look individual, but it just makes you blend in more, doesn’t it?” “She’s not very friendly lately, isn’t she?”, and with that sort of conference, they found out where Roswaal and Ram were.
